storage: Airtight jar or tin in a cool, dry place; sun-dry briefly in monsoon if pods feel soft; keep away from moisture.
looksLike: A shrivelled dark-red pod, about 5 cm long, with seeds inside; hot and smoky once fried in oil.
howToPick: Deep, even red colour, pods that are dry and crisp with an intact stem, a clean pungent smell. Avoid dull, dark-brown, damp or dusty pods, or any with white mould.
shelfLife: About 1 year if kept dry (general guidance, not from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 1 whole pod per serving (a shrivelled dark-red pod, about 5 cm long)
